probes.description: FORM P5-T2: the sample's experience `warehouse` is for role WarehouseManager. The shell /x/<experience>/ serves the static page (unknown experience 404); GET /api/x/me hands the caller the FIRST experience whose `for` matches a role of the caller (WarehouseManager: warehouse + its 3 reachable screens with dataUrl and startUrl; ADMIN and a plain USER: experience null, they keep the back office). POST /api/x/flows/<flow>/execute is the ONLY way an `expose: ui` flow is started from a browser: it answers 200 for a flow that is an action of a screen of the caller's experience (OneFlowUiOnly) and 404 -- indistinguishable from a missing flow -- for an internal flow, for a role outside `for`, and for a flow no experience screen of the caller names. The public flow route still has no start for a ui flow.

steps.name: the shell page of a known experience is served without data
the client module is a static file
the custom screen's component is served from web/regions and registers itself
a WarehouseManager lands in the warehouse experience
ADMIN has no experience: the back office stays
a plain USER has no experience either
a ui flow named by a screen action of the caller's experience starts
the same flow is 404 for a role outside the experience (ADMIN)
the same flow is 404 for a plain USER
an api flow named by the experience is 404 for a role outside it, although the public route would start it
an internal flow is never started from a screen
a flow no screen of the caller's experience names is 404
the public flow route still has no start for a ui flow
